options.content:
These are workload and collector measurements, not a third layer to add to host filesystem or Piraeus pool totals. CNPG database size is not total PGDATA filesystem use. SeaweedFS logical bucket bytes omit replicas; physical bucket and collection values overlap. ClickHouse MergeTree bytes are per-pod collector values.

Machine and Storage tier filter node-owned panels. SeaweedFS S3 bucket panels are cluster-wide and are not filtered by node ownership.

The Storage tier selector filters by node labels; Machine filters node-owned panels. This is node-level filtering. If a node later has both SSD and HDD, per-device media labels will be needed to separate those disks.

panels.title: CNPG database size by machine now
panels.description: CNPG exporter database-size values from pods on the selected machine. This database metric is not total PGDATA filesystem use; replicas report their own copies and must not be added across machines as unique data.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, namespace, job, datname) (cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes{datname!~"template0|template1"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: Largest CNPG databases by machine over time
panels.description: CNPG exporter database-size values from pods on the selected machine. This database metric is not total PGDATA filesystem use; replicas report their own copies and must not be added across machines as unique data.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (node, namespace, job, datname) (cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes{datname!~"template0|template1"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: SeaweedFS volume-server disks by machine now
panels.description: Volume-server all/available/used resource gauges from pods on the selected machine. These per-server values are collector detail and are not additive to the filesystem or Piraeus pool totals.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, pod, name, type) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_resource{namespace="seaweedfs",type=~"all|avail|used"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: SeaweedFS volume-server disk use by machine over time
panels.description: Volume-server reported used bytes per selected storage node and server disk. This is a per-collector view; do not add it to the independent pool and filesystem accounting layers.

targets.expr: max by (node, pod, name) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_resource{namespace="seaweedfs",type="used"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: SeaweedFS collection bytes by machine now
panels.description: Collection bytes reported by volume-server pods on the selected machine. Each replica is counted on its storage node; these collector values overlap physical bucket bytes.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (node, collection) (max by (node, collection, pod) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_total_disk_size{namespace="seaweedfs",type="normal",collection!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS collections by machine over time
panels.description: Collection bytes reported by volume-server pods on the selected machine over time. Each replica is counted on its storage node; these collector values overlap physical bucket bytes.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (node, collection) (max by (node, collection, pod) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_total_disk_size{namespace="seaweedfs",type="normal",collection!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: SeaweedFS S3 logical bucket size now (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Logical S3 object bytes by bucket across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership.

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS S3 logical buckets over time (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Logical S3 object bytes by bucket across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership; logical bytes omit replicas.

panels.title: SeaweedFS S3 physical bucket size now (cluster-wide)
panels.description: S3-reported physical bucket bytes across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership.

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS S3 physical buckets over time (cluster-wide)
panels.description: S3-reported physical bucket bytes across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership; these overlap with collection-level replica bytes.

panels.title: ClickHouse MergeTree bytes by machine now
panels.description: MergeTree bytes reported by ClickHouse pods on the selected machine, including the existing system-table metric. This per-pod collector detail is separate from host filesystem and Piraeus pool use.

targets.expr: sort_desc((max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTables{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})) + max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTablesSystem{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: ClickHouse MergeTree bytes by machine over time
panels.description: MergeTree bytes reported by ClickHouse pods on the selected machine, including the existing system-table metric. This per-pod collector detail is separate from host filesystem and Piraeus pool use.

targets.expr: (max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTables{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})) + max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTablesSystem{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})))
